title: Mike W NDE 122/20920 NDE 20920
content:
122 The pushbike rapidly gathered momentum as I pedaled hard down the hill. I could feel the December sun warm on my back and hear the wind whistling through my hair - it was good to be alive. I guess this enthusiasm for risk and speed was one of the contributing factors to the accident I was about to have. My pushbike was a fixed wheel racer, there was one gear with no free spin, and the pedals just kept coming around as the bike moved forward. As I leaned further into the corner to navigate the left hand turn, I could feel the wheels start to slide out on the loose gravel and then the pedals came around to lift the back wheel clean off the road! I had totally lost control of the bike. The bike leapt from the road, crashing out of control, and buckled into a mangled heap of twisted metal. At the same time, as a helpless passenger I was launched from the seat and hurtled through the air, smashing face first into the concrete curb. I was knocked out cold and lay on the road in a pool of blood totally unconscious. The lady in the nearby house seeing the accident happen ran screaming from her verandah to try and help. She lifted my limp hand but could not feel any pulse. The ambulance was called and I was rushed off to the hospital. I lay in a coma in the hospital bed for the next 5 days. I don't remember hitting the curb. Instead, I was standing on the side of a gently sloping hill. The grass lay flat on the undulating hill as if it had been wind swept over many years. I realized that I was not alone. Beside me stood someone dressed in brilliant white. The sky was totally dark behind me and to either side - but there was a light in front - over the top of the hill - a clean white light like the rising of the early morning sun. The person beside me, perhaps an angel or perhaps the Son of God, took me by the hand and we slowly walked up the hill together. And as we did the light shining beyond the top of the hill became brighter and brighter. The next moment I was looking over various scenes of my life - past, present and future. I saw my life replayed before me as if I was watching a three dimensional movie - a live drama. Each scene I saw in detail exactly how it happened, as I seemed to flick right through my life story right up to my present age of fifteen. Each scene was real with plenty of time to reflect, yet it all seemed to take no time at all. I felt very exposed watching all this, yet the one in white standing next to me did not appear to judge me - rather I seemed to judge myself. I saw myself standing on a stage in front of many people. Beyond the spotlight that shone out of the darkness, I could make out a sea of faces eagerly looking up towards the stage. The host motioned for me to step towards the microphone and as I moved forward, I began to speak the gospel message of Jesus Christ. Jesus loves you with an everlasting love. He loves you so much that he died in your place to free you from sin so you can experience new life in him. And then there were many hands being raised in response to the Gospel - to accept Jesus Christ as their Lord and Savior. As these scenes flashed before me, I realized that we had reached the top of the hill. Standing on the edge and looking out over the panoramic scene before me, I could see a city in the distance. It was sparkling in the sun as though it was made of glass like something you would read about in a fairytale story. The person in white was asking me if I wanted to enter into heaven - the holy city. If I saw it, I could never return to the earth or my family. Or did I want to go back into my physical body on earth. I was a Christian, having given my heart to the Lord at a young age of 10. I loved God but was mostly afraid to tell my friends at school, and pretty regular at going to church but that alone doesn't count for much. I would love to stay here in this wonderful place. But now I could see a glimpse of my family crying and praying for me. Not that I could earn my way to heaven, but rather I realized that my life on earth would be more fruitful if I chose to allow God's will to unfold in my life. My heart was divided. I wanted to stay here and enter into heaven, but I also sensed that God had a plan for me to be a part of. Maybe I should return to earth. Yes. I will go back. I had made the decision. I know I was shown more than this, yet the words kept ringing in my ears 'you will not remember the things you have seen, you will not remember the things you have seen....' It was like coming out of a fog, a deep sleep, and all the time I was trying to hold onto the many scenes as I could, but felt them slipping, slipping, slipping.... I could feel the clean sheets against my legs. There was a peace in the hospital room as I came out of the coma, and it is reported that I was humming the tune 'To God be the glory great things he has done'. After about a week, they let me look in the mirror. I didn't recognize myself - I was completely covered in scabs where the gravel scraped off my skin and stared back at myself out of two bloodshot eyes. Two of my teeth had been snapped in half. An experience I thought no-one would believe, but God had impacted my life. Fourteen years later, I was in Madras in India on a missionary trip. As I stood on the back of an oxen cart, stepped up to the microphone and shared the gospel message, I suddenly realized I had been here before. The light shone out of the darkness, the pastor gave an invitation to the audience and thirty to forty Indians raised their hands in response and asked Jesus into their hearts. God is outside time. He created time and space, the world and the universe, and has a plan for each one of us. Are you ready for the journey? ---------------------------------------- In addition to this account there are other events I have not included but I think are relevant. (1) I remember being in the hospital intensive care room - at about ceiling height. I saw two bodies on hospital beds but did not feel like I was supposed to belong to either. I heard them talking about one person that had been brought in that had been in a gas explosion and suffered burns over his body. (2) After I came out of my 5 day coma, I was allowed to look in the mirror. Scabs covered my whole body. Mum asked me if I remembered what had happened - because I had been in the intensive care room I thought at first that I had been in the gas explosion. (3) I had a sense whilst in my NDE that I knew heaps of information that I had never learned. Mum said that when I was in the coma I was reciting all the states of the USA etc. - I only know about five states!

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident COMA FROM HEAD INJURY ACCIDENT Life threatening event, but not clinical death My parents were convinced they would never see me again. (I do not know what the doctor's reports were). A later MRI scan of my brain shows minor damaged tissue at front and rear possibly resulting from this accident. | Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death Bike accident at high speed without helmet. Landed head first on curb.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was outside my body at about ceiling height. | Yes At first, I was seeing my body from ceiling height in intensive care. After that, I didn't think about if I was in my body or not. At the end, I felt myself coming back into my body.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Physically - in a coma. However I felt alert more than normal - an enhanced alertness. | My body was in a coma in intensive care. I was totally awake but not in the hospital.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Was totally outside time. | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning When I saw my life replayed. It seemed like it took forever but also was instantaneous.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain bright light brilliant like early morning sun. | Yes Saw heavenly city.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Angel (or Jesus Christ) | Yes Someone in white. I did not have to speak to know what they were thinking.
elements.The experience included: Void | Darkness | Light | A landscape or city | Special Knowledge | Life review | Vision of the future | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings | Out of body experience
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Bright light brilliant like early morning sun. | Yes Light brighter than morning sun, clean and bright. Did not hurt my eyes but gave me energy as I looked at it.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Saw a glistening city in the distance and had the choice to continue but could not return. | No
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe It was as if I knew all this information I had never learned. When I saw Jesus he did not speak to me - it was as if I knew exactly what he was thinking and he knew exactly what I was thinking. | Everything about the universe I had amazing knowledge when I was OBE. I just knew all things. It is reported that I quoted all states of America - to this day, I can only quote a handful.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw everything - including things I thought no-one else knew of. It was in 3 dimensional like it was actually happening. I was determined afterwards to avoid evil/sin.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Saw myself standing on stage in front of dark people speaking into a microphone. This happened so exactly when I was in India some 14 years later it was like 2 photos superimposed. | Scenes from the world's future Amazingly accurate.
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Yes Cavern. Did not cross. If I crossed, I would not have come back to life. | Yes Canyon. No, did not cross. Knew that if I did could not return.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Was torn between wanting to stay and wanting to return to earth for (a) my family and (b) to fulfill my destiny. | I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Didn't want to return but knew I should.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It was like another world - what I experienced cannot be completely described in words. Like at the start I felt like I was speeding through space, but not moving. I was outside time. Etc. | Yes Was so unreal that when I tried at first to share it didn't make sense to those who were listening.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Ability to prophecy and see visions, and have experienced the power of God in awesome way. | Yes Often see visions, dreams that come to pass. Have seen instant healing when I pray for people - deaf, blind, fevers, back pain, strokes etc.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best part - being in the presence of God. Worst part - seeing my life played out before me. | Best part - Feeling the elation of the light and where I was, no pain. Worst part - coming back.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Find it incredible but believe me. It is an encouragement to them. My parents also believe me and had a sense of peace when I was in the coma that I was in God's presence. | Yes They were encouraged that there is a purpose to life.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Another accident in 1980 - hit by a car. Left my body and saw myself lying on the road whilst looking down from above. | Yes Only the OBE. Have had another experience in 1980 - hit by a car. This time an OBE where I saw the accident from high as if I was in a helicopter. Crowd around the mangled pushbike. Came back into my body after someone from the crowd prayed for me.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: ife after death is a reality - it is only a breath away. I feel that more people (everyone) should take stock of their lives in this light and prepare for eternity. | Have had another experience in 1980 - hit by a car. This time an OBE where I saw the accident from high as if I was in a helicopter. Crowd around the mangled pushbike. Came back into my body after someone from the crowd prayed for me.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Yes - immediately after the NDE it was so unreal coming back into reality and such a contrast that I was hesitant to share with others on the misunderstanding that people would think I was mad. Has anybody else had this feeling? | Good questionnaire
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Totally natural, excitement - like I was made for this.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Confidence in God. Not scared of dying.
